enrichers.title: Asset enrichers
enrichers.intro: Enrichers read the asset's descriptive data (costs, countries, sectors, coupons) once a week. For each item the first enricher in the list that has it wins. You can correct an item by hand: it holds until a source reads it again.
enrichers.noneChosen: No enricher chosen: add one from the list below.
enrichers.othersHelp: Here are the enrichers you removed (with «+» to put them back), the new ones, and those that do not know the asset, with the reason. Where it makes sense you can search or type the identifier by hand.
enrichers.openPage: Open its page on the source
enrichers.resultHint: Choosing a result fills type and identifier. You can also type them by hand.
enrichers.testNotFound: With this identifier it finds nothing.
enrichers.testConflict: It names another asset than the one you have: check the identifier.
enrichers.testError: The source did not answer. Try again later.
enrichers.testRateLimited: Too many tests in a short time: wait a moment and try again.
enrichers.testOff: This enricher is not active on this instance.
enrichers.testNotConfigured: This enricher needs its settings first.
enrichers.issueTypeNotAccepted: This enricher does not read this identifier type

reasons.not_covering: does not cover this asset type
reasons.foundByTicker: found only with the ticker {ticker}: check it is this one

enrichers.notFoundWith: Nothing found with {type} {identifier}: correct it or search

line.running: Looking for the enrichers that know this asset with its identifiers… {answered} of {asked} answered
line.found: {count, plural, one {# enricher knows} other {# enrichers know}} the asset: {names}.
line.foundAdopted: Check the order and press «Use these enrichers»: they are saved with the asset.
line.foundOutside: The ones not in your list are under «Not in the list», with «+».
line.none: No enricher knows the asset with its identifiers: you can add one below.
line.refused: Too many requests to the sources: waiting, the search starts again by itself in a moment.
line.error: The enrichers could not be searched: add them by hand.
line.no_identifiers: The asset has no identifiers to recognise: add the enrichers from «Not in the list» below.
